sentences.text: Mr. Mukesh Kumar, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the instant petition with liberty to file the appeal.
With aforesaid liberty, this petition is permitted to be withdrawn and stands disposed of with the said liberty.
If any issue of limitation arises in filing the appeal, the pendency of the petition shall be considered by the learned appellate court.
